messages:
Maya K: kicking off azimuth-1 region bring-up. greenfield, 40x A10G target, internal-only for now. need quick sanity pass + SLO gate checks. tagging ops/sre for smoke and network checks @Devon C @Leo P
Devon C: on it — starting with network + quota verification. ETA ~45m for nodes to be Ready. do we have the final CIDR map? :eyes:
Maya K: CIDR map is the latest in runbooks (internal): https://internal.redwood/runbooks/azimuth-1-cidr. quotas confirmed by finance/cloud. SLO targets: p95 < 120ms for 512-token text-gen, node churn < 1% during ramp.
sre-bot: deploy job triggered: deploy/azimuth-bootstrap #4521 started by Maya K
Ash R: quick checklist I'll run (short form): MTU=9000 across edge->k8s (no fragmentation), ensure BGP session to transit, verify IGW/NAT egress rules, validate KMS access for node identities, NLB health check config (30s interval), kubelet flags and taints for inference nodes
Leo P: running quick smoke script now: `./tools/smoke/azimuth-smoke.sh --quick` — will validate node readiness, kube-proxy, simple inference probe, and metrics pipeline ingress.
Leo P: paste of commands I'm using:
```bash
# smoke snippet
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl -n inference get pods --show-labels
curl -fsS http://nlb-inference.azimuth.internal/healthz || echo NLB-FAIL
python3 tools/mini_infer.py --model small-test --prompt "ping" --count 3
```
Devon C: network checks complete — peer AS up, BGP prefixes learned, MTU validated. saw one subnet with overlapping tag (fixed), route table needed a more specific egress route for metrics (added).
Leo P: smoke results: nodes 40/40 Ready, kube-system pods stable, mini_infer responses 3/3 with avg latency 85ms. NLB returned 200 on /healthz. metrics pipeline accepted first events.
Ash R: parsed kubelet logs — one node had transient docker oom on image pull, restarted and came back Ready; will add to postmortem notes.
Maya K: great. remaining items before handoff: - run chaos-friendly restart test (drain 3 nodes) - run a 30m canary ramp with 10 qps to validate p95 stability - confirm cost delta for on-demand vs reserved for first month and flag procurement
Devon C: I'll start drain test and run traceroute-based tail latency probe.
Maya K: ops-runbook-bot: please create a handoff checklist entry and tag oncall for tomorrow's night window
ops-runbook-bot: created /handoffs/azimuth-1/2026-03-18 with checklist and assigned @Leo P and @Ash R (ETA review by EOD)
Leo P: observed p95 during brief ramp (10qps, 30m) = 110ms stable. no backpressure on queueing.
Maya K: ok — if nothing else blocks, propose to move to readiness review with product + infra. I'll post summary and schedule 30-min review. thanks all :thumbsup:
